_readme: Written by 'npm run discover:boards' (scripts/discover-boards.mjs) from config/companies.json. 'boards' are career boards that were found and confirmed to belong to the company; every sync crawls them (src/lib/feeds/company-boards.ts). 'needsReview' lists boards that exist but could not be confirmed: to accept one, copy its company, ats and slug into 'manual' below (the script never touches 'manual'). ats is one of greenhouse, lever, lever-eu, ashby, teamtailor.
